## Problem and result

Describe the concrete problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue, if any.

## Verification

List the commands and manual checks performed, with their results. For code or catalog changes, include `npm run test:ci`; explain any failure or check you could not run.

For visual changes, include before/after screenshots from a temporary generated design and note the themes, viewports and keyboard checks. For behavior changes, describe the reproduction or regression test.

## Compatibility

Describe changes to existing tokens, props, schemas, generated interfaces or agent instructions, and any migration needed. Write “None” if there is no compatibility impact.
